title: Filming, recording: One Hand Clapping by Wings | 1974
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

An orchestral session for Wings’ documentary One Hand Clapping was held at Abbey Road on 29 August 1974.

The session was scheduled at short notice, after Paul McCartney decided to sweeten some of the week’s recordings. He hired conductor and arranger Del Newman to recruit the necessary players, and also asked saxophonist Howie Casey, who had performed on Band On The Run, to attend.

Prior to the session musicians arriving, Wings recorded takes of ‘Band On The Run’ and ‘Bluebird’. These, as with the rest of the week’s work, were filmed by director David Litchfield’s crew.

The orchestral musicians then accompanied Wings for versions of ‘My Love’, ‘Live And Let Die’, ‘Band On The Run’, ‘Bluebird’, and ‘Jet’.
